title: P2 principal.data_request: request
description: A person's request about their own data (/mydata erase in a direct chat) or a request by a person with admin:people about a principal of their tenant: a SubjectRequest of kind erase in v0.1, export since v0.2 (SEC-11, D-76). A confirmed erasure goes as an erasure request with the reason subject_request.

subject.description: Only a person with admin:people: whom the request is about; without the field the request is about oneself.
